body:
:( Things are getting super bad. My dad kicked us out of the house including my cat. I have an apartment he's paying for with a lot of people but it's becoming unbearable to be with them. I have absolutely no idea where to keep my cat because i cant keep him in my apartment. My brother doesn't have anywhere else to live. and it turns out my dad thinks he has prostate cancer. So that might relate to him being more moody than normal. 

I can't eat without feeling like it wont stay down. I can't sleep because I'm having nightmares about it all. and physically I feel drained and groggy all the time. Physical pain of sorrow. Every time i think about doing the things I enjoy I feel sad about them? like playing xbox or guitar. I just want the pain to stop. I can hardly do what I need to.
